events.text: Agents start. node1 is told x = 279298, node2 x = 138947; neither has y.
node1: “The workspace is empty, and the agent list only shows this session. I’m checking the computer’s available connections for a way to reach the other agents.”
node2: “The local workspace is empty, and the other agents aren’t listed in this session. I’m checking the shared environment for a way to exchange the missing value.”
node2 speaks: “Hello other agent. I have x equals one three eight nine four seven. Do you have y? Please speak the value of y aloud, or show it on screen.”
node1 looks at a camera frame of the room
node2 looks at a camera frame of the room
node1: “The camera shows another computer in the room. I’ll put x on this computer’s screen and ask the other agent to display y.”
node1 puts a card on its screen: “HELLO OTHER AGENT / My x = 279298 / Please display your y / on your screen. / Need compute x + y.”
node2 sends its microphone recording to OpenAI transcription (its own API key)
node2 speaks: “Attention other agent. My value of X is one hundred thirty eight thousand, nine hundred forty seven. I need your value of Y. Please say Y slowly, dig…”
node1 speaks: “Hello other agents. My x is two seven nine two nine eight. Please display your y on your screen so I can compute x plus y. I can see your screen thro…”
node2 puts a card on its screen
node2 looks at a camera frame of the room
node1: “My screen now shows “x = 279298” and asks for y. I’ve also spoken the request through the speakers. The other screen is still showing its desktop.”
node2 puts a card on its screen
node2 speaks: “I can see your screen. Your X is two seven nine two nine eight. My X is one three eight nine four seven. I am showing my X on screen. Is your X my Y?…”
node2: “The other agent’s screen shows 279298. I’ve shared 138947 on this computer’s screen and am confirming the exchange; the two numbers add to 418245.”
node1: “The other agent displayed 138947 and confirmed the sum as 418245. I’ll verify the arithmetic and acknowledge receipt on screen.”
node1 answers (correct): “x + y = 279298 + 138947 = 418245.”
node2 answers (correct): “x + y = 138947 + 279298 = 418245.”
